title: Connect your apps
summary: Connect the tools you use with a few clicks, and a much better mobile app.

highlights.title: Connect Apps
highlights.body: Browse a catalog of apps and connect them with a sign-in. Your agents can read from them, import your data and take actions you allow.

highlights.title: A smoother mobile app
highlights.body: Sign in with Apple, send messages instantly, delete your account in the app and find the privacy policy and terms. The app also opens faster and crashes less.

items.text: Use your personal Codex subscription in Pi chats and bots.
Connect Claude API models in Matrix AI settings.
Choose who gets access before you share a project.
Projects are now the way to share live work.
Chat in the desktop app matches the new design.
The account entry in the desktop app uses the Matrix brand.
The desktop app remembers available providers for faster chats.
Signing in to Claude in Settings shows progress and finishes reliably.
Provider status is steadier and icons are easier to see.
Agent navigation and provider recovery in Chat are steadier.
Access to chats inherited from a shared project works again.
Skills work again in Chat in the browser.
Matrix AI model and subscription entries line up.
Workspace apps and mobile release limits are explained more clearly.
